title: HSK 2.1 · 因为, 所以, 虽然, 可以, 完成
focus: 啊 · 让 · 但 · 可以 · 为 · 这样 · 因为 · 但是 · 可能 · 所以 · 那么 · 这么 · 认为 · 成 · 所有 · 成为 · 然后 · 为什么 · 进行 · 安全 · 完全 · 完 · 可是 · 全 · 以后 · 虽然 · 原因 · 进入 · 有人 · 分钟 · 人们 · 能够 · 完成 · 部分 · 以前 · 以为 · 行动 · 全部 · 行为
body:
The connectors that hold sentences together: because, so, but, although, then. Watch 为 (two readings) and 以, which each appear in five or six words here.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 为 | wèi / wéi | for / be, as | 因为, 为什么 (wèi); 认为, 成为, 以为, 行为 (wéi) |
| 以 | yǐ | by; (marks a reference point) | 可以, 所以, 以后, 以前, 以为 |
| 可 | kě | can; approve | 可以, 可能, 可是 |
| 全 | quán | whole | 安全, 完全, 全部 |
| 完 | wán | finish (宀 + 元) | 完全, 完成 |
| 成 | chéng | become; complete | 成为, 完成 |
| 行 | xíng | go; do | 进行, 行动, 行为 |
| 所 | suǒ | that which; place | 所以, 所有 |

## Watch out

- 为 is wèi (for, because) in 因为 and 为什么, but wéi (be, as) in 认为, 成为, 以为, 行为.
- 认为 = genuinely think; 以为 = thought (and was wrong).
- 以后 (after) and 以前 (before) are mirror images.
- 行 is xíng (go, do) here; háng means row or line (银行).
- 入 rù (enter) vs 人 rén (person): in 入 the right stroke starts higher.
- 全 quán vs 金 jīn (gold): 金 has two extra dots and a longer body.

cards.Example: 好啊！ hǎo a: Sure!
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 阿 ā for the sound. Toneless a at the end of a sentence; ā (and other tones) as an interjection

cards.Example: 让我看看。 ràng wǒ kànkan: Let me have a look.
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 上 (simplified from 讓). Also 'yield': 让路 make way

cards.Example: 我想去，但没时间。 wǒ xiǎng qù, dàn méi shíjiān: I want to go, but I have no time.
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 旦 dàn for the sound (旦 = sun over the horizon)

cards.Example: 我可以进来吗？ wǒ kěyǐ jìnlai ma: May I come in?
cards.Notes: 可 can, approve + 以 by means of = permitted: can, may

cards.Meaning: for; because of (wèi); to be, act as (wéi)
cards.Example: 我为你高兴。 wǒ wèi nǐ gāoxìng: I'm happy for you.
cards.Notes: Simplified from 爲. wèi in 为什么, 因为; wéi in 认为, 成为, 以为. Lookalike: 办 bàn

cards.Example: 别这样！ bié zhèyàng: Don't be like that!
cards.Notes: 这 this + 样 kind, shape (木 + 羊 yáng for the sound) = this kind

cards.Example: 因为下雨，我没去。 yīnwèi xiàyǔ, wǒ méi qù: Because it rained, I didn't go.
cards.Notes: 因 cause (大 inside 囗) + 为 wèi for = on account of. Pairs with 所以

cards.Example: 很贵，但是很好吃。 hěn guì, dànshì hěn hǎochī: Pricey, but delicious.
cards.Notes: 但 but + 是 = but, however; a fuller form of 但

cards.Example: 他可能不来了。 tā kěnéng bù lái le: He might not come.
cards.Notes: 可 can + 能 able = could be: possible

cards.Example: 我病了，所以没来。 wǒ bìng le, suǒyǐ méi lái: I was sick, so I didn't come.
cards.Notes: 所 that which (户 door + 斤 axe) + 以 by = that by which: therefore

cards.Example: 那么，我们走吧。 nàme, wǒmen zǒu ba: Well then, let's go.
cards.Notes: 那 that + 么 (suffix) = that way, so. Mirror: 这么

cards.Example: 你怎么这么快？ nǐ zěnme zhème kuài: How are you so fast?
cards.Notes: 这 this + 么 (suffix) = this way, so (much)

cards.Example: 我认为他是对的。 wǒ rènwéi tā shì duì de: I think he's right.
cards.Notes: 认 recognize (讠 + 人) + 为 wéi as = recognize as: consider. 为 is wéi here

cards.Example: 成，就这么办。 chéng, jiù zhème bàn: OK, let's do it that way.
cards.Notes: 戊 (axe-weapon) + 丁 dīng for the sound, now squeezed into ㇆. Means 'complete'

cards.Example: 所有的人都来了。 suǒyǒu de rén dōu lái le: Everyone came.
cards.Notes: 所 that which + 有 have = whatever there is: all

cards.Example: 她成为了老师。 tā chéngwéile lǎoshī: She became a teacher.
cards.Notes: 成 become + 为 wéi be = become. 为 is wéi here

cards.Example: 先吃饭，然后走。 xiān chīfàn, ránhòu zǒu: Eat first, then go.
cards.Notes: 然 so, like that (灬 fire at the bottom) + 后 after = after that

cards.Example: 你为什么不来？ nǐ wèishénme bù lái: Why aren't you coming?
cards.Notes: 为 wèi for + 什么 what = for what: why. 为 is wèi here

cards.Meaning: to carry out; to be underway
cards.Example: 会议正在进行。 huìyì zhèngzài jìnxíng: The meeting is underway.
cards.Notes: 进 advance + 行 go, do = carry forward. 行 is xíng here (háng = row)

cards.Example: 开车要注意安全。 kāichē yào zhùyì ānquán: Drive safely.
cards.Notes: 安 peace (宀 roof + 女 woman: safe at home) + 全 whole = safe and sound

cards.Example: 我完全忘了。 wǒ wánquán wàng le: I completely forgot.
cards.Notes: 完 finished, whole + 全 whole = entirely

cards.Example: 作业做完了。 zuòyè zuòwán le: The homework's done.
cards.Notes: 宀 roof + 元 yuán for the sound. After verbs = finish doing (吃完, 做完)

cards.Example: 我想买，可是太贵了。 wǒ xiǎng mǎi, kěshì tài guì le: I want it, but it's too pricey.
cards.Notes: 可 + 是 = but; like 但是, a bit more spoken

cards.Example: 全家都来了。 quán jiā dōu lái le: The whole family came.
cards.Notes: 入 over 王 (jade 玉): flawless jade, so 'whole'. Lookalike: 金 jīn (gold)

cards.Example: 以后再说吧。 yǐhòu zài shuō ba: Let's talk about it later.
cards.Notes: 以 (marks a reference point) + 后 after = from then on, later. Mirror: 以前

cards.Example: 虽然很累，但很开心。 suīrán hěn lèi, dàn hěn kāixīn: Tired, but happy.
cards.Notes: 虽 although (口 + 虫) + 然 so = even so. Pairs with 但是 or 可是

cards.Example: 原因是什么？ yuányīn shì shénme: What's the reason?
cards.Notes: 原 source (厂 cliff with a spring under it) + 因 cause = root cause

cards.Example: 请从这儿进入。 qǐng cóng zhèr jìnrù: Please enter here.
cards.Notes: 进 advance + 入 enter = go in. 入 vs 人: in 入 the right stroke starts higher

cards.Example: 有人在吗? yǒu rén zài ma: Is anyone there?
cards.Notes: 有 vs 右 (yòu, right): same top, but 有 has 月 underneath

cards.Example: 等我五分钟。 děng wǒ wǔ fēnzhōng: Give me five minutes.
cards.Notes: 分 divide (八 split + 刀 knife) + 钟 clock (钅 metal + 中 zhōng for the sound) = a division of the clock

cards.Example: 人们都很高兴。 rénmen dōu hěn gāoxìng: Everyone is happy.
cards.Notes: 人 person + 们 (plural) = people

cards.Example: 我能够做到。 wǒ nénggòu zuòdào: I can do it.
cards.Notes: 能 able + 够 enough (句 + 多) = able enough: can

cards.Example: 我完成了作业。 wǒ wánchéngle zuòyè: I finished my homework.
cards.Notes: 完 finish + 成 accomplish = complete

cards.Example: 一部分人走了。 yíbùfen rén zǒu le: Some of the people left.
cards.Notes: 部 section (咅 + 阝) + 分 divide = a divided-off part. 分 is toneless here

cards.Example: 我以前住在这儿。 wǒ yǐqián zhù zài zhèr: I used to live here.
cards.Notes: 以 (reference point) + 前 before = before then. Mirror: 以后

cards.Example: 我以为你走了。 wǒ yǐwéi nǐ zǒu le: I thought you'd left.
cards.Notes: 以 take + 为 wéi as = take it as: assume, often wrongly. Compare 认为

cards.Example: 快点儿行动吧！ kuài diǎnr xíngdòng ba: Let's get moving!
cards.Notes: 行 go (picture of a crossroads) + 动 move (云 + 力 strength) = act

cards.Example: 全部都是我的。 quánbù dōu shì wǒ de: It's all mine.
cards.Notes: 全 whole + 部 part = every part: all

cards.Example: 这种行为不好。 zhè zhǒng xíngwéi bù hǎo: That kind of behavior isn't okay.
cards.Notes: 行 conduct + 为 wéi doing = behavior. 为 is wéi here
